A few common questions
Will my writing still sound like me?+

Yes. The aim is to clarify your writing while preserving your ideas, argument and individual voice.

What’s the difference between proofreading and editing?+

Proofreading focuses on language and consistency. Developmental editing offers a broader perspective on structure, flow and the clarity of your argument.

How do you approach academic integrity?+

Our approach supports your own work. We do not write assignments for you or supply arguments, research or original content. Always check your institution’s guidance.
